a: Boys and girls in kindergarten through fifth grade from Parkmont Elementary and other surrounding Fremont schools are all welcome.

q: Where and when do you meet?
a: We meet at the Veterans Memorial Hall in Niles, Fremont. Den and pack meetings happen 2–3 times per month, on Wednesdays from 7–8pm.

q: How do I enroll a new scout?
a: Visit a meeting, enroll with Scouting America and pay national/council fees, submit the Pack 269 application form and pack fees, then purchase a uniform. Full steps are on the Join Pack 269 page.

q: How do I renew for a returning scout?
a: Renew and pay national/council fees at my.scouting.org before your renewal date, then submit a Pack application form with your Pack fee check. Details on the Join Pack 269 page.
Nothing — all Pack leaders are unpaid volunteers. Pack fees only cover activity materials, meeting space, campground rent, and scout awards.

q: What if we can't afford registration fees?
a: Pack 269 policy is to help families facing financial hardship. Let a Pack leader know — contact pack269info@gmail.com.

q: Where can I find the Pack calendar and roster?
a: Enrolled families get access through Scoutbook. See the Contact page if you need help getting access.

q: What council and district are we part of?
a: Pack 269 is part of the BSA Golden Gate Area Council, Mission Peak District, chartered by American Legion Post 837.
